title: Building Your Timeline, Deadlines & Support Network
summary: Learn how to organize transition actions into a realistic timeline, track deadlines, and identify people and resources that can help.
objectives: Place transition actions in a logical sequence.
Distinguish fixed deadlines from target dates.

vocab.def: A date or time by which an action must be completed.
A planned completion date used when no external deadline exists.
A step that must happen before another step can begin or finish.
People or organizations that can provide information, guidance, review, or assistance.

sections.heading: Some steps must happen before others
sections.body: Applications, credentials, interviews, training, and other actions may depend on earlier steps being completed.

sections.heading: Deadlines should come from reliable sources
sections.body: Important deadlines should be checked against the actual provider or canonical opportunity information.

sections.heading: Target dates help when no deadline exists
sections.body: Reasonable target dates can keep research, preparation, portfolio work, and applications moving.

sections.heading: Different questions need different support
sections.body: Instructors, counselors, employers, providers, mentors, families, and credential issuers may support different transition tasks.

practice.prompt: An application is due March 15 and a transcript may take two weeks. Should you wait until March 14?
practice.answer: No. The transcript is a dependency and should be requested early.

practice.prompt: Who should confirm an external training deadline?
practice.answer: The program or another authoritative source for that program.

quiz.question: Why identify dependencies?
options: Some actions must happen before later actions can succeed
quiz.answer: Some actions must happen before later actions can succeed

lab.objective: Turn a simulated transition plan into a 12-week timeline with dependencies, deadlines, target dates, and support contacts.

reflectionPrompt: Who would you include in your support network when an important next step is unclear?
